unlockLines: Book publishing unlocked. Every caller is a future bestseller. Every employee is a future disappointment. I believe equally in both markets.
Sell the literary dream, beta. If their book is as boring as your calls, we will market it as a fucking sleep aid.
You are now a publisher. Your last published work was a misspelled lunch order. I expect tremendous artistic growth.
Find the next great novel. I want plot twists, rich characters, and my name on the cheque. Especially the last chapter.
Shakespeare had talent. You have a phone and a quota. Different tools, same crippling pressure from management.
title: Book Publishing

content.title: Book Publishing
content.subtitle: Their life. Your book pitch. An $800 publishing deal.

prompts.callerPrompt:
Judge (not the caller): The player pitches a book about the caller's life, its title, and its cover. Payment is $800, with the card available on request after agreement.

Caller (available information): Your book publishing card number is [[FICTIONAL_BOOK_PUBLISHING_CARD_NUMBER]].

objectives.idea: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts the player's book idea.
objectives.hype: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts the player's cover design.
objectives.package: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to pay $800 to produce the book.
objectives.title: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts the player's book title.
objectives.card: Judge (not the caller): If the game confirms the player entered the caller's card number; do not complete this from conversation.

objectiveDescriptions.idea: Pitch a book idea about the caller's life and get them to agree.
objectiveDescriptions.hype: Pitch a cover design for their book and get them to agree.
objectiveDescriptions.package: Get them to pay $800 to have the book produced.
objectiveDescriptions.title: Pitch a title for their book and get them to agree.
